name: @estate/vault-web
description: The ISOLATED VAULT ORIGIN (docs/03 TB6). A small node:http edge that redeems the cross-origin handoff, holds a __Host- session cookie scoped to this origin alone, and proxies the vault service on the caller's own bearer — plus a FRAMEWORK-FREE browser client, so the one origin holding Zone A keys has no dependency tree and can run under a CSP with no unsafe-inline and enforced Trusted Types.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && node scripts/copy-vault-crypto.mjs
